cues: The vital capacity, the most you can breathe out after the deepest breath, is tidal plus both reserves: four thousand six hundred.
Add the residual volume for the total lung capacity: five thousand eight hundred.
One trap: a spirometer can never see the residual volume, so it cannot measure total lung capacity either.
text: Capacities are sums of volumes. The vital capacity, the most you can breathe out after the deepest breath, is tidal plus both reserves: four thousand six hundred. Add the residual volume for the total lung capacity: five thousand eight hundred. One trap: a spirometer can never see the residual volume, so it cannot measure total lung capacity either.
